notes.title: Update 1.5.4 now available - and an announcement!
notes.notes:
1.5.4 is now available! The big addition for 1.5.4 is are the "Fast Track" actions. These can be found in the consultants menu and allow you to spend influence to get one-time boosts. And they can be repeated - if you have enough influence!

We're also announcing a new content pack - [b]Miami Malls[/b] - which will be available on July 13. Check out the store page for more details!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/636500/Project_Highrise_Miami_Malls/

[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]New "Fast Track" actions in the Consultants dialog. You can spend influence to get one-time boosts, and repeat them as many times as desired (but their price goes up over time). Each fast track action unlocks only after unlocking the entire category of upgrades.
[*]New one-time event for tourist/entertainment events to match the business event
[*]New keyboard shortcuts
[list]
[*]Infrastructure: Z (bulldoze), X (build floor), C (build standard elevator)
[*]TAB (press repeatedly to pan camera to top floor, ground floor, and return)
[*]Shift-Q / Shift-E (zoom all the way in or out)
[*]R (show ADA reports)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam build: visual updates to the main menu, bottom info bar
[*]Updates to French, German, Italian, Russian and Spanish translations
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with hotel, casino and event related one-time events occurring without the appropriate things being built
[/list]


Complete history of release notes:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 is live!
notes.notes:
[b]Rooftop restaurants, holiday decos and more![/b][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/fe06ceaa5651f1bd44af496f40aedad292ede75e.gif[/img]

[b]*** Version 1.3.0 (December 7, 2016)[/b]

[b]New Additions[/b]
[olist]
[*][b]Rooftop Restaurants and Penthouse Apartments[/b]. They combine indoor and outdoor elements, and can only be placed on the top floor.

[*][b]Winter Holiday Decorations[/b]. Deck the halls with new decos for the holiday season, including Christmas trees and more!

[*][b]Unlimited Mode[/b]. When you don't want to worry about the economics, and just want to architect the greatest building in the world, check out this mode under "New Game".

[*][b]New scenario:[/b] Going Green
[/olist]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Occasional snow flurries instead of rain, somewhat randomly, depending on the day of the year
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where some restaurants were overly sensitive to losing regular customers
[*]Confirmation dialogs (ok/cancel) should no longer hide the dialog over which they are displaying
[*]Fixed bug with "It's a Steel" media campaign not working on cantilevered floor
[/list]

Happy Holidays and Happy New Year to everyone from SomaSim! See you next year!

notes.title: Announcing 1.2.0 - the "Petronas Towers" update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/78cbd509ecea7c13af77d90b9043e072dddbc2d3.jpg[/img]

*** Version 1.2.0 (November 9, 2016) 

[b]New Additions[/b]
[olist]
[*][b]Skybridges.[/b] You can now place a skybridge that connects two towers. Skybridge tiles can contain decorations and furniture, and carry utilities, but cannot be leased to tenants.

[*][b]Cantilevered floor.[/b] You can place a floor that extends up to four tiles beyond existing floor immediately below.
[/olist]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]When placing utilities, hold down SHIFT to auto-fill an entire empty floor (the floor needs to have an existing closet, already hooked up to the rest of the network)
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]"New Game" dialog now remembers the last-chosen sandbox difficulty level and lot size
[*]Fixed the custodial room showing a "services full" or "unhappy" notifs
[*]Fixed a bug where removing a storage room assigned to a retail store did not reduce the store's happiness.
[*]Fixed a bug with small plaza tiles not showing up after placement
[/list]
And if you're enjoying this update along with our previous updates, we'd really appreciate a review!

[i]Full release notes[/i]
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Building Amenities is live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/432f0e882d282002dd6dfaf9d467d390158046d5.jpg[/img]
Here are the details of the 1.1.0 content update.
[list]
[*][b]Vending machines[/b] are small additions that will help make your residents happy. It gives them a place to take a quick break and escape from their desks for a few minutes. If there is a vending machine on the same floor, chances are that at break time, you’ll see some office workers head over to grab a snack.
[*][b]Pay phones[/b] provide a place for office and apartment dwellers to converse privately in public. Look for them to head there when they need a break to phone home or to make a call away from prying eyes. Since privacy requires some soundproofing, these will also cut the spread of noises a bit as well. Like vending machines, residents will only go to pay phones located on the floor where they live or work.
[*][b]Shoe shine stations[/b] help residents keep their fancy footwear in top form. They’ll visit them during break-time or free time if they are located on the same floor as their office or apartment.
[*][b]Common areas[/b] are relaxing oases from the rigors of urban life. Residents will seek them out during off hours for a few calm moments. They also slightly reduce the spread of noises and smells.
[*][b]Custodial supply rooms and broom closets[/b] help reduce wear and tear and cut down grime. As your building grows, you’ll be able to unlock a supply room that will allow you to place up to three broom closets. If a broom closet is built, grime will accumulate much more slowly for tenants on the same floor as the broom closet. Gaining more prestige will grant you access to more supply rooms and allow placement of more broom closets. Since you are only able to build a few of these, make sure that you place them on high-traffic floors or areas that quickly accumulate grime!
[/list]

Full release notes can be accessed here: 
http://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 has arrived
notes.notes:
Here are the details about what's been changed and updated in 1.0.6!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/3ea8894895197041c1080cbc83400664efc2ef99.gif[/img]

Improvements
- Reduced the traffic impact that people have on their own offices and apartments
- Reduced the frequency of elevator breakdowns
- Adjusted color palette for character clothing, make them a clearer match for workplaces
- Service placement mode is "sticky" until the user right-clicks out of it
- Tenant move-out improvements:
-- New pop up ticker alerts the player when a tenant suddenly moves out
-- Click on the ticker to pan the camera over to their former location
-- Click on debris left behind to get more info on why they moved out
- Upgraded to Unity engine 5.4.1

Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug where overlays would appear shifted over narrow lots (scenarios and sandbox)
- Fixed a bug where placing a utility every second tile would cost half as much as it should
- Fixed a bug where executive and regular elevators could be attached together
- Fixed a bug where placing a large utility meter did not include utility lines in same location

[url=http://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt]Full release notes can be accessed here![/url]

- Added a fast camera pan mode: CTRL + mouse wheel now pans the camera up and down
- Retuned worker and resident NPCs to patronize retail stores much more than they used to
- Retuned retail store revenues and limits, to account for the change in customer base
- Retuned restaurants and retail to be more sensitive to not generating enough profit

Bug fixes
- Fixed arrow keys so that they behave exactly like WASD, +/- behave like Q/E
- Fixed a bug where the budget popup would show up twice in a row, give double revenues
  (This should also fix restaurants + retail incorrectly showing "0 customers yesterday")
- Fixed a problem with media campaign "Call in a Favor" not unlocking an extra contract
- Fixed broken achievements for 5 and 10 scenario gold medals
- Fixed a bug where floor tiles would remain unfinished forever, if you destroyed 
  the construction office while construction workers were finishing them
- Fixed art gallery consultants incorrectly demanding utilities
- Fixed a bug where construction grid was displayed mis-aligned after a height upgrade
- Fixed loan repayment so it will show up in reports as a one-time expense not a daily one
- Fixed a bug where a mis-timed renovation could bring the player's cash amount below $0
- Fixed the renovation button to very clearly gray out if a renovation was already scheduled
- Fixed a display bug where a new scenario would briefly show incorrect cash amount at startup
- Steam: fixed the game becoming unresponsive after a problem connecting to the Steam Client


And if you haven't yet, please leave us a review on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/423580]the game's store page[/url], we'd really appreciate it! :)

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 is live
notes.notes:
Enhancements and bug fixes abound:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/a013e68fca1316c74ebe0883f410639a59e946f5.png[/img]

We've been following your feedback on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/423580/discussions/]the forums[/url], and have another set of fixes and enhancements ready! 

Improvements
- Enabled Steam Cloud syncing
- Added UI scaling below 100% (for displays smaller than 720p)
- Retuned higher-level tenants to make fewer service calls
- Initial construction office can now be removed, and placed elsewhere
  (it shows up in the infrastructure build menu after bulldozing)

Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug with courier and copy center services not reporting correctly
- Fixed UI scaling selection not getting saved
- Fixed incorrect logging of "I can't get to where I need to go" feedback
- Fixed a bug with some gourmet restaurants not being counted in goals
- Fixed a bug with cleaner service causing navigation problems for workers
- Fixed incorrect rent pricing for studio apartments
- Fixed some incorrect animations for restaurant visitors
- Fixed the "+1 construction worker" upgrade getting undone if the player
  bulldozed and rebuilt the expanded construction office
- Services will no longer consider themselves "overloaded" if only a small 
  number of service calls (<= 3) were not fulfilled
- Fixed achievements that were failing to register: the tutorials-related achievement,
  and on Steam, two mods-related achievements
- Wording improvement: clarified placement requirements based on media campaigns
- Fixed inconsistency with "Exclusive Electricity" media campaign,
  now power/water meters get discounted in addition to conduits and closets
- Fixed sports bar not getting counted as a large dinner restaurant in contracts
- Fixed some prestige inconsistencies 

You can find full release notes here: 
http://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt 

And if you haven't yet, we'd really appreciate your review on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/423580]the game's page[/url]! :)

notes.title: Now Available for Pre-Purchase | Workshop Confirmed | Release Date Confirmed
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/02802968f5c2863ec9cf0e74c5c7d978d75e7fe7.gif[/img]

For a limited time only, get in on the ground floor and pre-order Project Highrise to access the game on day of release, as well as [b]seven exclusive in-game decorative items[/b] to spruce up your burgeoning skyscrapers.

1.	Aurora, a statue inspired by the dawn of modernism.
2.	A bold standing light to adorn and illuminate.
3.	Catalonia chair. A stylish standby of skyscraper lobbies.
4.	A cubist fountain with water gently cascading over carved granite.
5.	An elegant teak table, a curvaceous, contemporary design.
6.	Brünn chair. A sleek statement of modern interior design.
7.	Carrara marble walls - the height of sophistication.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Workshop[/h1]

We are also confirming that we are working on Steam Workshop to support MODs for Project Highrise.
Thanks to the large demand that has been shown within the Steam Community for MOD support we have started to implement the functionality officially

[i]More details to come on how this will function and how you can craft MODs for Project Highrise.[/i]


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Release Date[/h1]

What you've all been waiting for!
We are proud to announce that the Release date for Project Highrise is; [b]September 8th[/b], 2016.

We'd like to thank you for all the support so far and all the support we are sure that you will give in the coming months. Thank you for your unwavering patience and unbelievable  commitment to creating a great new community within our world of Project Highrise.

We are still taking all feedback, so head back over to the forums and show your love!
